title: "4. Microcontrollers"

This strand begins only after students complete digital voltage levels, pull resistors, active-low logic, debouncing, GPIO compatibility, and the circuits culminating project.

Planned device pathways include Arduino-compatible boards, Raspberry Pi, micro:bit, and other available controllers. Every activity must identify the exact board, GPIO voltage, current limits, and protection requirements rather than assuming all devices behave alike.

The first programming activity will reuse the same active-low switch circuit from the D01 module so students can separate hardware behaviour from code behaviour.
